status: Agreed generation contract; plan and source hashes are recorded separately before dataset generation
partition_rule: Sort IDs0..4095 by SHA256('HyperNet-v11-2D-family-split-1:'+decimalID). First2048 train,next128 dev,next128 test; remainder reserved. Distractors exclusively from the same partition, excluding enrolled family.

targets_npz.union_mask: bool[256,256]; union of all rendered foreground shapes
targets_npz.target_mask: bool[256,256]; enrolled microvariant foreground on positives, allFalse on negatives
targets_npz.candidate_mask: bool[256,256]; candidate foreground for provenance and diagnostics only

bbox_convention: xyxy in pixel coordinates; exclusive right/bottom; tight foreground bounds
counterbalance: Two enrollment variants per family. Shared candidate scene pixels are intentionally reused with opposite labels, making presence depend on the support. No shared grammar families, object seeds, or decoded pixels across train/dev/test. Candidate query is an independently jittered macro instance, with +/-3% axis/connector variation from support. Both microstates have equal continuous removed area and primitive count; rasterized ink counts can differ slightly.
inference_access: Model receives only support RGB/support box and query RGB. Query boxes, masks, object roles, family labels and presence labels are evaluation targets, never inference inputs.
scope: Heldout grammar combinations share designed mathematical building blocks; they are not new semantic natural-object categories. No natural images or external pretrained weights.
